mapper.update: UPDATE erp_time_table SET yy = #{dto.yy}, mm = #{dto.mm}, dayname = #{dto.dayname}, period_no = #{dto.periodNo}, start_time = #{dto.startTime}, end_time = #{dto.endTime}, class_key = #{dto.classKey}, unit_key = #{dto.unitKey}, grade_key = #{dto.gradeKey}, user_code = #{dto.userCode}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student_attendance (student_id, attendance_key, time_table_key, center_code, week, created_at) SELECT #{studentId} AS student_id, 'before' AS attendance_key, #{timeTableKey} AS time_table_key, #{centerCode} AS center_code, w.week AS week, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS created_at FROM (VALUES ('ju_1'), ('ju_2'), ('ju_3'), ('ju_4')) AS w(week) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM erp_student_attendance sa WHERE sa.student_id = #{studentId} AND sa.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND sa.week = w.week)
mapper.select: SELECT tt.id AS timeTableNo, time_table_key AS timeTableKey, period_no AS periodNo, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, yy AS yy, mm AS mm, dayname AS dayname, tt.class_key AS classKey, tt.unit_key AS unitKey, cc.class_type AS classType, cc.class_name AS className, uc.unit_name AS unitName, G.grade_key AS gradeKey, g.grade_name AS gradeName FROM erp_time_table tt JOIN erp_class_code cc ON tt.class_key = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON tt.unit_key = uc.unit_key JOIN erp_grade_code g ON tt.grade_key = g.grade_key WHERE yy = #{year} AND mm = #{month} AND user_code = #{userCode} ORDER BY dayname, period_no

SELECT st.student_id AS studentId, st.student_name AS studentName, tta.week AS week FROM erp_time_table_assign tta JOIN erp_student st ON tta.student_id = st.student_id WHERE tta.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} ORDER BY st.student_name

SELECT tt.id as timeTableId, tt.time_table_key as timeTableKey, tt.period_no as periodNo, tt.start_time as startTime, tt.end_time as endTime, tt.yy as yy, tt.mm as mm, tt.dayname as dayname, cc.class_name as className, uc.unit_name as unitName, g.grade_name as gradeName FROM ERP_TIME_TABLE tt JOIN erp_grade_code g ON tt.grade_key = g.grade_key JOIN erp_class_code cc ON tt.class_key = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON tt.unit_key = uc.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON tt.user_code = u.user_code WHERE tt.yy = #{year} and tt.mm = #{month} and tt.period_no = #{periodNo} and tt.dayname = #{dayname}

SELECT s.student_id AS studentId, s.student_name AS studentName, t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, tc.time_table_ym AS ym, sa.week AS week, sa.in_time AS inTime, sa.out_time AS outTime, ac.attendance_name AS attendanceName, r.absence_date AS absenceDate, r.remedial_date AS remedialDate, r.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM ERP_TIME_TABLE t JOIN ERP_TIME_TABLE_CODE tc ON t.time_table_key = tc.time_table_key JOIN ERP_TIME_TABLE_ASSIGN ta ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key JOIN ERP_STUDENT s ON ta.student_id = s.student_id JOIN ERP_STUDENT_ATTENDANCE sa ON s.student_id = sa.student_id JOIN ERP_ATTENDANCE_CODE ac ON sa.attendance_key = ac.attendance_key LEFT JOIN ERP_REMEDIAL r ON s.student_id = r.student_id AND t.time_table_key = r.time_table_key WHERE t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey} AND sa.week = #{week}

SELECT CASE #{week} WHEN 'ju_1' THEN bc.ju_1 WHEN 'ju_2' THEN bc.ju_2 WHEN 'ju_3' THEN bc.ju_3 WHEN 'ju_4' THEN bc.ju_4 ELSE bc.ju_1 END AS content, bc.before_class_key AS beforeClassKey, t.time_table_key AS timeTableKey, tc.time_table_label AS timeTableLabel, u.user_name AS userName FROM erp_before_class bc JOIN erp_time_table t ON bc.class_key = t.class_key AND bc.unit_key = t.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON t.user_code = u.user_code JOIN erp_time_table_code tc ON t.time_table_key = tc.time_table_key WHERE t.unit_key = #{unitKey} AND t.class_key = #{classKey} AND t.time_table_key = #{timeTableKey}

SELECT * FROM erp_remedial r JOIN erp_student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_user u ON r.user_code = u.user_code WHERE r.user_code = 'DAE001cos' AND substring(r.absence_date, 1, 4) = #{year} AND substring(r.absence_date, 6, 2) = #{month}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_remedial SET action = #{action}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE remedial_key = #{remedialKey}
UPDATE erp_remedial SET remedial_date = #{remedialDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE remedial_key = #{remedialKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO erp_student_attendance (in_time, student_no, created_at, attendance_no, center_no) VALUES (#{inTime}, #{student.studentNo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{attendanceCode.attendanceCodeNo}, #{center.centerNo})
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_student_attendance SET out_time = #{outTime}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE student_no = #{studentNo} AND out_time IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT student_attendance_no, in_time, out_time, attendance_date, student_no, attendance_no FROM erp_student_attendance WHERE student_id = #{studentId}

SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, t.time_table_key, m.question1, m.question2, m.question3, m.question4, m.question5, m.question6, m.question7, m.question8 FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id JOIN erp_time_table t ON t.time_table_key = ta.time_table_key LEFT JOIN erp_monthly_score m ON m.time_table_key = t.time_table_key AND m.student_id = ta.student_id WHERE t.time_table_key = #{classCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE erp_monthly_score SET question1 = #{score.question1}, question2 = #{score.question2}, question3 = #{score.question3}, question4 = #{score.question4}, question5 = #{score.question5}, question6 = #{score.question6}, question7 = #{score.question7}, question8 = #{score.question8}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND time_table_key = #{classCode} AND yy = #{yy} AND mm = #{mm}
